name: Neches River at Evadale
note: Below both Sam Rayburn and B. A. Steinhagen. Stage is partly a reservoir-release signal, not pure drought.
stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

name: Neches River near Rockland
note: Above Steinhagen. Unregulated; one of the two reference gauges that define low-flow dates.
stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

name: Angelina River near Alto
note: Above Sam Rayburn. Unregulated. Biggest drought swing in the record: 3.2 m below the growing-season median in 2011.
stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

name: Neches River near Town Bluff
note: At the B. A. Steinhagen dam. Stage is set by dam operation. Included for contrast, not for drought.
stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level
